fields.DESCRIPTION: Add a touch of regal charm to your home décor with this exquisite Royal Rajasthani Brass Embossed Chowki. Handcrafted by skilled artisans of Rajasthan, this decorative chowki features intricate floral embossing on a gleaming brass surface, resting elegantly on four claw-foot legs. Traditionally used in Indian households for placing idols during pujas or as a base for sacred items, this piece also makes for a stunning accent table or gift.
